body_markdown:
**Join us in Houston for this year’s PWX Public Works Expo 2026, we would love to meet you; Drop by our exhibition space booth 1339 and request a custom tour of our EV ARC™ charging systems.**


**Event:** PWX Public Works Expo 2026


**Date:** August 30–Sept 2, 2026


**Location:** George R. Brown Convention Center 1001 Avenida De Las Americas Houston, Texas 77010


**Registration is now open.**


Come and discover more about our patented EV ARC™ , the only 100% renewable, transportable, off-grid EV charging option on the market. It is a versatile energy infrastructure product with a sleek aesthetic design that fits in the size of a standard parking space.


- Rapidly deployed sustainable EV charging
- No electrical work, no construction, no utility bill
- Fits in a standard parking space so EVs can park on the base pad with no loss of precious parking
- Any brand charger pre-mounted at the Beam factory
- Permanent yet movable, the EV ARC™ can be relocated quickly and easily


**What is PWX Public Works Expo?**


PWX provides a first-class multi-modal learning experience designed for professionals at all levels and across the entire spectrum of public works. Come prepared to see, hear, touch, and discuss in a variety of traditional and interactive sessions, seminars, workshops, and networking opportunities. Attendees can also spend time on North America’s largest exhibit floor for public works equipment and services—we’ve carved out generous portions of non-compete time, so you don’t miss any sessions. Kick tires, talk about technology, or get the scoop on new products.


**Can’t make it to PWX Public Works Expo?**


No problem. We’re always available to help you design the perfect solution for your EV charging requirements. Click[here](https://beamforall.com/about/contact-us/) to contact one of our experts.


We look forward to seeing you,


The Beam Team
